name: track quality index
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 用于综合表征轨道几何状态的指标。
usage_overview: 用于评价区段轨道几何平顺状态，比较不平顺程度或描述沉降引起的几何质量变化。既可用于整体评价，也可考察高低等单项不平顺；按标准差表征时，其数值对应所选的不平顺分量。

complete_examples.text: Apart from predicting the long-term evolution of track irregularity amplitude and the track quality index, the PSD evolution model can be perfectly united with the train–track interaction model and a pseudo-excitation method to reveal the long-term evolution of system behaviours no matter on response amplitudes or on their characteristic frequencies against different confidence intervals.

Generally, the purposes of the evolution model for track irregularities are to predict the track geometrical characteristics, e.g. maximum amplitude, track quality index (TQI), and to achieve the long-term dynamic assessment.

With regard to the track irregularity simulation, a model is newly developed to obtain random sample sets of track irregularities by transforming its power spectral density function into the equivalent track quality index for representation based on the discrete Parseval theorem, where the correlation between various types of track irregularities is accounted for.
